Sub Main()
  Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value2 = IsNull((Null & Null) + 1)
  Worksheets(1).Range("A2").Value2 = IsNull(Not (Null & Null))
  Worksheets(1).Range("A3").Value2 = IsNull((Null + 1) And True)
  Worksheets(1).Range("A4").Value2 = IsNull((Null = Null) + 1)
  Worksheets(1).Range("A5").Value2 = IsNull((Null + 1) = "x")
  Worksheets(1).Range("A6").Value2 = IsNull((Null & Null) = 1)
End Sub

Sub Main()
  Dim value As Variant
  value = Null & Null
  Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value2 = IsNull(value + 1)
  Worksheets(1).Range("A2").Value2 = IsNull((Null & Null) + 1)
  value = Null + 1
  Worksheets(1).Range("A3").Value2 = IsNull(value And True)
  Worksheets(1).Range("A4").Value2 = IsNull((Null + 1) And True)
End Sub

provenance.note: A source-level Variant temporary does not change a supported expression's Null semantics.

Sub Main()
  Dim count As Long
  If Null + 1 Then
    count = 100
  Else
    count = 1
  End If
  While Null & Null
    count = 100
  Wend
  Do
    count = count + 1
  Loop While +Null
  Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value2 = count
End Sub

provenance.note: Computed Null values are false in supported condition contexts, exactly like a direct state or a Variant holding it.

provenance.note: A computed Null selector has the same no-match behavior across scalar Case values as a Variant holding Null.

End Sub
Function FirstValue() As Variant
  Worksheets(1).Range("B1").Value2 = "first"
  FirstValue = Null
End Function
Function SecondValue() As Variant
  Worksheets(1).Range("B2").Value2 = "second"
  SecondValue = Null
End Function
